chipmunk.name: Chip
chipmunk.description: A tiny, bright, high-pitched cartoon chipmunk. Fast, excitable, warm, slightly squeaky, youthful, very expressive.

wolf.name: Warden
wolf.description: A deep, calm, clear guardian with a wolf in his voice: a low rumbling growl sits under every word, slightly gravelly and husky, with a faint wolfish rasp at the start of phrases. Slow, steady, few words, protective, serious, never mean. Clear and easy to understand.
